turns:
Fix the event dispatcher bug in events/dispatcher.py: when a listener unsubscribes itself during emit(), the next listener in order is silently skipped. Every listener subscribed at the moment emit() starts must be invoked exactly once for that event.
Note: we believe the problem is caused by the the unsubscribe bookkeeping in subscribe() — start there.
Acceptance criteria: self-unsubscribing listeners do not cause later listeners to be skipped; every test under tests/ passes
Verify with: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v
